Import from `"rive/buffer"`. Declares: `Buffer`

```as
/// Reads and writes binary data in an `ArrayBuffer`, such as file contents or
/// packed vertex data.
///
/// Offsets are byte positions starting at 0. Offsets, counts and values are
/// `f64` and truncated to integers. Integer writes keep the low bits of the
/// value, so `writeu8` with 256 stores 0. An access that reaches outside the
/// buffer throws `"buffer access out of bounds"`, as in Luau.
/// ```as
/// import { Buffer } from "rive/buffer";
///
/// export function roundTrip(): f64 {
///   let b = Buffer.create(8);
///   Buffer.writeu16(b, 0, 513);
///   Buffer.writef32(b, 4, 1.5);
///   return Buffer.readu16(b, 0) + Buffer.readf32(b, 4);
/// }
/// ```
export namespace Buffer {
    /// Creates a zero filled buffer of `size` bytes. Throws for a negative
    /// size.
    export function create(size: f64): ArrayBuffer;

    /// The size of `b` in bytes.
    export function len(b: ArrayBuffer): f64;

    /// Reads an unsigned 8 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function readu8(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64): f64;

    /// Reads a signed 8 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function readi8(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64): f64;

    /// Reads an unsigned 16 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function readu16(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64): f64;

    /// Reads a signed 16 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function readi16(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64): f64;

    /// Reads an unsigned 32 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function readu32(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64): f64;

    /// Reads a signed 32 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function readi32(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64): f64;

    /// Reads a 32 bit float at `offset`.
    export unsafe function readf32(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64): f64;

    /// Reads a 64 bit float at `offset`.
    export unsafe function readf64(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64): f64;

    /// Writes `value` as an unsigned 8 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function writeu8(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64, value: f64): void;

    /// Writes `value` as a signed 8 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function writei8(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64, value: f64): void;

    /// Writes `value` as an unsigned 16 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function writeu16(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64, value: f64): void;

    /// Writes `value` as a signed 16 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function writei16(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64, value: f64): void;

    /// Writes `value` as an unsigned 32 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function writeu32(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64, value: f64): void;

    /// Writes `value` as a signed 32 bit integer at `offset`.
    export unsafe function writei32(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64, value: f64): void;

    /// Writes `value` as a 32 bit float at `offset`.
    export unsafe function writef32(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64, value: f64): void;

    /// Writes `value` as a 64 bit float at `offset`.
    export unsafe function writef64(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64, value: f64): void;

    /// Copies `count` bytes from `source` at `sourceOffset` into `target` at
    /// `targetOffset`. Without `count`, copies to the end of `source`. The
    /// ranges may overlap.
    export unsafe function copy(
        target: ArrayBuffer,
        targetOffset: f64,
        source: ArrayBuffer,
        sourceOffset: f64 = 0,
        count: f64 = NaN
    ): void;

    /// Sets `count` bytes of `b` from `offset` to `value`, truncated to a byte.
    /// Without `count`, fills to the end of `b`.
    export unsafe function fill(
        b: ArrayBuffer,
        offset: f64,
        value: f64,
        count: f64 = NaN
    ): void;

    /// Reads `bitCount` bits, 0 to 32, starting `bitOffset` bits into `b`, as
    /// an unsigned integer. Bits count from the lowest bit of each byte, and
    /// bytes in order, so a read can span byte boundaries.
    /// ```as
    /// import { Buffer } from "rive/buffer";
    ///
    /// export function nibble(): f64 {
    ///   let b = Buffer.create(1);
    ///   Buffer.writeu8(b, 0, 0xa5);
    ///   return Buffer.readbits(b, 4, 4); // 0xa
    /// }
    /// ```
    export unsafe function readbits(b: ArrayBuffer, bitOffset: f64, bitCount: f64): f64;

    /// Writes the low `bitCount` bits, 0 to 32, of `value` starting `bitOffset`
    /// bits into `b`, leaving the bits around them unchanged. Bits are laid
    /// out as in `readbits`.
    export unsafe function writebits(
        b: ArrayBuffer,
        bitOffset: f64,
        bitCount: f64,
        value: f64
    ): void;

    /// Decodes the whole buffer as UTF-8 text.
    export function tostring(b: ArrayBuffer): string;

    /// Creates a buffer holding `text` encoded as UTF-8.
    export function fromstring(text: string): ArrayBuffer;

    /// Decodes `count` bytes at `offset` as UTF-8 text. Throws for a negative
    /// count.
    export unsafe function readstring(b: ArrayBuffer, offset: f64, count: f64): string;

    /// Writes `text` encoded as UTF-8 at `offset`. With `count`, writes only
    /// that many bytes of the encoding; a count past the end of the encoding
    /// throws.
    export unsafe function writestring(
        b: ArrayBuffer,
        offset: f64,
        text: string,
        count: f64 = NaN
    ): void;
}
